## What changes?

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in the public GALDUR repository.

## Scope

- [ ] Methodology / documentation (CC BY 4.0)
- [ ] Reusable template payload (MIT)
- [ ] Community, legal, or repository maintenance

## Verification

- [ ] I checked the rendered CS and EN surfaces affected by this change.
- [ ] I checked links, version references, and template field names.
- [ ] I added a changelog entry when the change affects a release.
- [ ] I included no secrets, internal paths/hosts, customer data, or private workflow details.
- [ ] I understand that my contribution is licensed under the license of the area it changes.

## Evidence

List the checks performed, screenshots if useful, and related issue/discussion.
